message: Ah, storms. They can feel a bit like nature's way of reminding us to cozy up with a good book—or maybe a cup of tea. I find that knowing how to handle a little rain or even a flood can turn a potentially chaotic situation into a snug indoor adventure. If you're looking for some helpful tips on staying safe and prepared, I stumbled upon a great resource that covers everything nicely. What’s your go-to cozy activity when the weather keeps you inside? ☔
